biggest_catch: Direct Listing is still marked Beta — expect the workflow and support quality to be rougher than ThredUp's mature Clean Out service.
catches: Zero seller fees and you keep 100% — but YOU do the listing work (photos, pricing, shipping).
Flat-rate USPS shipping label; you're responsible for printing and dropping off.
Paid when the buyer accepts the item — returns go to ThredUp, handled on your behalf.
This is distinct from ThredUp's Clean Out consignment (3–80% payouts, $14.99 service fee): Direct Listing is the peer-to-peer path with no fees.
Requires the ThredUp app to list; best for premium/high-value items you want control over.

maximize: Use Direct Listing (0% fees) for your best premium pieces and Clean Out consignment for everything else — the split matches each path's strengths. Price with ThredUp's AI smart-pricing recommendations but check recent sold listings for the same brand; AI suggestions skew toward fast sales, not maximum price. Since you keep 100%, there's no fee penalty for pricing higher and waiting. Photograph well: the 'one-tap' AI background removal makes phone photos look studio-quality, and better photos drive faster full-price sales.
notes: Grounded on ThredUp's official direct-listing page. Distinct from Clean Out: P2P with 0% fees, seller does the listing. Marked Beta — disclosed.

repeatable.cadence: Repeatable per item — list again every time you have clothes to sell. Best for premium items you want pricing control over.
